blocks.text: MANDAUE CITY, Cebu – Mandaue City Hospital is planning to add 10 beds to its existing 25-bed capacity amid a surge in dengue admissions. Hospital head Dr. Ligaya Lakambini Dargantes said the hospital can accommodate only 10 additional beds due to space limitations within the facility. She clarified that the hospital’s 25-bed capacity is not exclusively allotted for dengue patients, as the beds are also used for adult medical cases, obstetrics, surgery and other medical needs.
